task: Owned cancellable metadata filesystem work and copied-extension cleanup scheduling

validation.reference: Actual Qt recording executed successfully on owned temporary files
validation.source_checks: Formatter, git diff --check, Python syntax and cached warning-aware Slint source compiler passed
validation.rust_tests: Authored store/native regressions await root hosted CI; no local Cargo

entries.behavior: Apply first commits every database timestamp update, then starts a captured ordered modified-time worker. Each file preserves atime and gets milliseconds plus its accepted step; missing files are skipped and permission failures are reported. Cancellation stops between files without rolling back database updates or the durable disk prefix. Exact title/gauge and strict delayed popup publication use the existing real popup consumer. Parent Apply cannot bypass an open date child; Cancel and retired child/parent callbacks cannot launch work or affect a successor.

reference_recording.result: Successful actual Qt v688 recording through serialized with-oracle on a fresh copied basic client; clean shutdown. Real EditFileTimestampsPanel and EditFilesForcedFiletypePanel are accepted or rejected through scripted modal return values. Accepted callbacks dispatch their unchanged real worker bodies; real UpdateFileModifiedTimestampMS and ChangeFileExt run on owned temporary files. Nine cases cover stepped millisecond updates, early and partial cancellation, strict >3-second popup delay, zero/one/65-file force operations, cancellation inside first or final 64-file block, and injected MergeFile PermissionError causing real MirrorFile plus cleanup command at now+3600. Actual JobStatus records titles, text, gauges, publication, cancellation, completion and dismissal. Two real rejected dialogs enqueue no worker and issue no writes. Only dispatch/clock/job cancellation/pauser/database command capture and one rename failure are supplied; DB command capture does not claim actual Python DB writes. The sandbox denied unrelated local API socket startup; Qt and filesystem recording succeeded.

limits: Both original Partial leaves and broader Manage Times/Force Filetype parents remain Partial; zero eligible completion promotions and no aliases/menu/parent credit.

Native finite workers use owned thread cancellation and existing persisted popups. Retired dialogs/children cannot apply or clear successor slots; accepted workers outlive their closed editor. UI completion is collected by GUI-owned weak timer callbacks. Native and store regressions are authored for hosted CI, not run locally.

Windows file-lock/path-is-free behavior, same-file/hardlink destinations, cross-device/read-only overwrite and extended metadata/permission recovery are not reference-recorded here. Native shared imported media is copy-only and per-hash media claims protect each file, but the full Python prefix-lock manager and concurrent storage-relocation lifecycle are not claimed.

Normal popup publication/cancellation/completion paths are recorded; reference exception presentation and global thread/shutdown/controller lifecycle remain unproven. Native errors finish the current popup and publish an owned error popup; spawn failure is fallible and currently reported to the caller/log. No full generic worker-family promotion.

Copy fallback schedules the existing DeleteNeighbourDupes backend at now+3600; the new regression checks strict queue eligibility at +3600/+3601 and bytes/mtime preservation. It does not execute the maintenance runner or prove unavailable-file retry behavior. Existing runner implements neighbour removal; cleanup lifecycle remains part of the Partial limit.
No local Cargo builds/tests, mutation tests, pushes, installed-reference writes, remote services or IPFS. Formatter, git diff --check, Python syntax and cached warning-aware Slint compilation passed.
